Outlier Robust PCA: Noiseless Setting In this section, we present our algorithm TORP(Algorithm 1) that applies to the special case of noise-less data, i.e., when M ∗ = L∗ + C ∗ , L∗ is rank-r, µ-incoherent matrix. While restrictive, this setting allows us to illustrate the main ideas behind our algorithm approach and the analysis techniques in a relatively simpler fashion.
